note: Decree of 13 November 2024 on the computerised identity card. It states nothing on how a station records a report or a case. The identity card is a civil identity system, which the typology does not class; the lost-card register kept at the commissariat is a station register for one function, with no statement that it is digital, and a decree places nothing.
